scope: Four output-blind development-only nominations. Source-game-disjoint from prior recorded public cases; source labels are not judgments and this reused fixture is not a holdout.
order: Deterministic selection, written board hypotheses, independent legal replay and bounded engine corroboration, then classifier outputs, then adjudication and frozen observable tests.

cases.hypothesis: Bf1 interposes against Qa1's rank check while threatening an attack on h7. It resembles a defensive counterthreat; a root deflection needs an actual forced displaced defender, not the source label or the later pawn capture. Enumerate all check evasions, queen captures and mate parries. Unknown root certificate.
cases.judgment: Bf1 is a legal defensive interposition with a deeper counterthreat. The current immediate/checking-mate-in-two nomination does not prove it. Later mating evidence must stay at its own ply. Source deflection is not a proved root label; empty root output is not positional ground truth.

timeline.label: Mating Attack
timeline.evidence: Qxh7 creates the new threat Qh8#. Stopping the mate concedes material: after Ke8, Qg8+ Kd7 Qxf7+ wins material. All 35 legal replies allow a verified local material gain or mate, including captures and counterchecks. This proves a material concession, not a forced-mate claim; later mechanisms belong to their actual moves.

cases.hypothesis: Ra1 prepares Ra7 against Qf7. The offered rook may lure the queen off the eighth rank while Qh8+ and Qxh7+ lead to collecting it. Root Ra1 is a multi-move preparation, not immediate interference or skewer. Full all-reply relevance unproved; keep later mechanism at its actual ply.
cases.judgment: Ra1 is a quiet preparation for Ra7 and a later queen-winning checking sequence. Current root certificate and all-reply lesson are unresolved. Neither an immediate interference/skewer headline nor a positional-negative label is adjudicated from the supplied line.

cases.hypothesis: Qxe3+ vacates g5 for Bf6-h4; fxe3 also vacates f2 on the mating diagonal. Qe2 may provide a distinct mating reply, so source-line clearance could be branch-specific. Independently verify mate in two and exact named-bishop geometry; root forced mate should lead over sacrifice/clearance if every reply mates.
cases.judgment: Qxe3+ forces mate in two: fxe3 Bh4# or Qe2 Qxe2#. Mate in 2 is primary. The supporting Mating Deflection is not an independent pawn win or a merely material attack. Clearance/Boden geometry belongs to the actual mating branch.

motifs.label: Forcing Mate
motifs.evidence: Qxe3+ starts a forced mating attack. Every legal defence permits mate within 2 moves; one verified line is Qxe3+ fxe3 Bh4#. The exact continuation depends on the defence.

motifs.label: Deflection
motifs.evidence: Qxe3+ offers the queen to deflect the pawn from f2. Accepting with fxe3 allows Bh4#: the pawn no longer blocks the mating line from h4 to e1. Declining can avoid this mate, but every legal decline has a checked material win or immediate mate. For example, Qe2 Qxe2#. This is not a forced-mate claim.

cases.hypothesis: Rd8+ starts a checking attack, with Kf7 as a possible alternative to source Kh7. Qh3+ Qh6 Rh8+ induces a king decision and can collect Qh6, but Kg7 may decline Kxh8 while allowing Qxh6+ protected by Rh8. A source attraction tag must not become unconditional forced attraction; verify every root and later king reply.
cases.judgment: In the actual Rh8+ Kxh8 Qxh6+ branch the queen capture follows a rook offer and must not be called an additional free queen. Exact all-reply guard-displacement evidence supports a Deflection Payoff. No history means this compensation must not be invented. Root-only completeness and general forced-attraction recall are not claimed.

motifs.label: Forcing Attack
motifs.evidence: Rd8+ starts a checking attack that wins material or mates against every legal reply. After Kh7, Qh3+ Qh6 Rh8+ Kxh8 Qxh6+ wins material. The continuation depends on the defence; later pins and forks belong to their actual positions, not the opening check.

motifs.label: Deflection
motifs.evidence: Rh8+ draws the king from h7 to h8, removing its protection of the queen on h6. In this line, Kxh8 Qxh6+ wins that target. Every legal defence concedes material or immediate mate.
